name: hud_ui_triplet_destructor_core
description: HudUiTriplet::DestructorCore destroys owned header panels and row cells, frees the scoreboard entry vector, clears owned pointers, and tears down the base container.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred; no VC target currently covers 0x40e070.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40e070 installs g_HudUiTriplet_FTable, scalar-deletes three header panels, scalar-deletes 24 row-cell panels, frees entries.begin, clears entries begin/end/cap, and calls HudUiContainer::DestructorCore.

Native smoke zhud_triplet_destructor_core_smoke constructs a HudUiTriplet, installs a one-entry scoreboard vector, calls DestructorCore, and verifies the base container vtable, entry-vector pointers, header panel pointers, and all row-cell pointers are cleared.
